message.content: I'm ending my turn without trading or mortgaging. I own both dark blues (Park Place and Boardwalk) but have only $165, and a house there costs $200. I'm keeping both railroads unmortgaged: they bring in rent, and I can mortgage them for cash if I land on a hotel.
message.reasoning:
I only have $165 cash despite the dark blues monopoly, and houses cost $200 each, so I can't build yet. Mortgaging the railroads would bring in $365, enough to build one house on either Park Place or Boardwalk while staying within the even-building rule.

Opponents have hotels pumping out $550+ rents, so keeping the railroads unmortgaged as emergency liquidity seems safer than overextending now. Trading away Indiana or North Carolina doesn't look appealing either since it'd hand opponents stronger monopolies — probably best to just end the turn.
